From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StarkCloud payment routing and remit preferences - Kickoff

Hi Evan —

Welcome, and thanks for partnering with Redwood. We9re starting vendor onboarding so our finance and procurement teams have everything they need to set you up in our AP system and ensure POs route correctly. To keep this tight, could you send the following by EOD Friday?

- Completed W-9 (or local tax form if not US)
- Bank details (account name, routing/IBAN, SWIFT/BIC) and a bank letter or voided check to validate account ownership
- Confirm preferred payment method: ACH (US), domestic wire, or international wire
- Remittance email address(es) for invoice delivery and any PO reference requirement
- Preferred invoicing format: PDF via email, vendor portal upload, or invoice push (SFTP/API)
- Any required remittance strings or PO line references we should include on POs (ex: GL code, project code)

Internal notes: Marcus, can you confirm Redwood9s default payment terms and whether we should offer net30 or net45 for this vendor? Laura, FYI for vendor master data.

Thanks — attaching our vendor onboarding checklist for reference (no sensitive info in the doc itself).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

- W-9: attached (W9_StarkCloud.pdf)
- Bank details: ACH preferred for USD payments. See bank letter attached (StarkCloud_BankLetter.pdf).
  - Bank: First Bay Commercial Bank
  - Account name: StarkCloud, Inc.
  - ABA/Routing: 121000358
  - Account number: ****5678
  - SWIFT: FBCBUS33
- Payment method: ACH (US) preferred; can accept wire for urgencies (confirm before sending)
- Remittance email: remit@starkcloud.io (please route invoice PDFs to this address)
- Invoicing: PDF via email preferred. We also support vendor portal uploads (link below) if you prefer automated ingestion.
- PO reference: Please include PO number and project code (PROJ-STK) on the invoice to avoid delays.

I also attached our invoicing instructions doc. If you need any bank verification call, our treasury lead is cc'd on the vendor portal link.

Thanks,
Evan Lewis

StarkCloud, Inc.
